assertion_review.conditions_for_failure: The mean (within 0.1), share (within two points) and rate (within 2 percent) assertions redden if the code reports an instant count, divides tokens by the wrong span, or excludes gate-wait arrivals; the partition assertion at :101 reddens if the split loses or double-counts below-width seconds beyond one second per hour.
assertion_review.independence: The expected values 11.10/0.682/434 and 1.66/0.003/113 are literals taken from the evidence scripts' logs, not read back from the code under test.
assertion_review.limit: The test does not read occupancy-fed.log at run time, so a later drift of the document away from the evidence scripts would only be caught by whoever edits the literals.

assertion_review.conditions_for_failure: The 90 percent starved attribution fails if a starved window is attributed to no-slots-offered, and the fed-versus-starved comparison fails on a split that answers the same part to both windows.
assertion_review.independence: Both sides are computed from the committed receipt excerpt through the public entry point; the threshold comes from the done_when.
assertion_review.limit: Both windows come from one fixture day, so a capacity rule wrong in one direction could stay under the 0.90 threshold.

assertion_review.conditions_for_failure: The pause control reddens if the pause is dropped from the split (demonstrated: assert 600.0 == 0.0 in logs/s6-negative-control.log), the unpaused mirror reddens if the split answers no slots to everything, and :190-192 redden if the pause is read back from the latest flag instead of recorded when it happened.
assertion_review.independence: The ledger is built by the test and the expected split follows from the stated rule, not from the returned block.

assertion_review.conditions_for_failure: live_runs == 2 and approx(2.0) redden if the ledger or the sweep drops occupancy; line 215 reddens only if the router stops copying the window mean into the admission block, never if that mean is wrong.
assertion_review.independence: Line 215 is not independent: both sides read the same dict entry assigned at imas_ambix/agent/router.py:967-969.
assertion_review.limit: The section-4 equality clause of the done_when is checked on a synthetic ledger only.

assertion_review.conditions_for_failure: The last-hour token totals redden if pruning drops to the slot window (100 instead of 700), and the withheld-capacity assertions redden if a guessed capacity is published for an unkeyed record.
assertion_review.independence: Expected counts are the token figures supplied to the ledger; the assertions test retention and refusal, not a copy of a returned value.

findings.text: non-blocking: the assertion compares document["mean_in_service"] with utilisation["window"]["mean_in_service"], and imas_ambix/agent/router.py:967-969 assigns the section-4 field from exactly that dict entry, so both sides move together and it stays green for any wrong mean; the independent pin is line 216's approx(2.0) on a 2-in-service ledger.
